services.faqTitle: Common Queries About Healthcare Google Ads, Answered

faqs.q: What does a healthcare Google Ads agency do?
faqs.a: A healthcare Google Ads agency runs paid search for hospitals and clinics. Reinvent Digital builds campaigns by procedure and centre, tracks calls and conversions, and optimises for bookings.

faqs.q: How is healthcare Google Ads different from general PPC?
faqs.a: Healthcare Pay-Per-Click (PPC) follows stricter rules: Google's healthcare and personalised advertising policies, NMC guidance and the ASCI code. Call tracking matters more, because many patients phone rather than fill forms.

faqs.q: How much should a hospital or clinic spend on Google Ads?
faqs.a: It depends on procedure, city and competition. Dental Google Ads leads typically cost ₹120–250 in Tier-2 cities and ₹180–500 in Hyderabad, Bangalore and Mumbai. Cost per booking matters most.

faqs.q: Can clinics use remarketing on Google Ads?
faqs.a: Rarely. Google treats health conditions and invasive procedures as sensitive for personalised ads, so most treatment-based remarketing is restricted. We rely on search intent, location targeting and contextual signals instead.

faqs.q: How soon will Google Ads bring bookings?
faqs.a: Google Ads usually produces meaningful data within 30 to 45 days. Budget decisions follow from day 60 to 90, once tracked bookings show which procedures, keywords and centres to scale.

faqs.q: How do you connect Google Ads to walk-ins?
faqs.a: Within the Reinvent Digital Patient Acquisition System, each enquiry enters your CRM with its campaign source, and bookings are matched to clinic attendance records where you allow access.

closing.heading: Ready to Put Google Ads to Work For Your Clinic?
closing.body: Share your account, and we'll show you where spend leaks, which searches lead to bookings, and what to fix first.

faqs.q: Can hospitals and clinics advertise on ChatGPT in India?

faqs.q: Where do ChatGPT ads appear?
faqs.a: Below ChatGPT's response, clearly labelled and separate from the answer. Ads reach logged-in Free and Go users aged 18+, and don't appear in personal or mental health conversations.

faqs.q: Does ChatGPT share patient conversations with advertisers?

services.faqTitle: What Healthcare Leaders Ask About Walk-In Tracking

faqs.q: What is healthcare walk-in tracking?
faqs.a: Healthcare walk-in tracking matches booked appointments to attendance records in your PMS, HIS or scheduling system, so you know which marketing sources produce patients who actually arrive.

faqs.q: Does walk-in tracking require PMS or HIS access?
faqs.a: It works best with authorised PMS or HIS access, but approved exports or structured front-desk logs can also work. We assess what your centres already record first.

faqs.q: Can every walk-in be matched to a source?
faqs.a: No. Missing phone numbers, shared family numbers and unrecorded visits leave some walk-ins unmatched. We report those openly, with a match rate, instead of guessing.

faqs.q: How is patient privacy protected?
faqs.a: Only the minimum fields needed for matching are used, under agreed permissions and retention rules. Access and responsibilities are defined with your team, in line with India's DPDP Act.

faqs.q: Why choose Reinvent Digital for walk-in tracking?
faqs.a: Reinvent Digital has tracked walk-ins across a 115+ location dental group, from 5,500 to 11,500 a month in 8 months, and reports unmatched visits openly.

faqs.q: How does walk-in tracking complete the Patient Acquisition System?
faqs.a: Walk-in tracking is the final stage of the Reinvent Digital Patient Acquisition System: demand, response and booking are all judged by the patients who actually arrive.

closing.heading: Of Last Month's Bookings, How Many Actually Walked In?
closing.body: Tell us which systems record your visits, and Reinvent Digital will show what can be matched, what's missing, and how soon walk-ins become measurable.

services.faqTitle: What Healthcare Leaders Ask About Follow-Up

faqs.q: What is healthcare messaging and follow-up?
faqs.a: Healthcare messaging and follow-up is how a clinic acknowledges, owns and follows up every patient enquiry across WhatsApp, calls and email until it books, drops or opts out.

faqs.q: Which channels can be used for patient follow-up?
faqs.a: WhatsApp, phone calls and email, plus SMS where your system supports it. Every channel needs patient consent, and WhatsApp uses approved templates outside the 24-hour reply window.

faqs.q: How is this different from marketing automation?
faqs.a: Marketing automation runs journeys on its own, such as reminders and recalls. Messaging and follow-up is people-led: owners, call cadences and real conversations with undecided patients.

faqs.q: How do you avoid messaging patients too often?
faqs.a: Every journey has a purpose, a frequency limit and a stop rule. Opt-outs are honoured immediately, and journeys end as soon as a patient books or declines.

faqs.q: Why choose Reinvent Digital for patient follow-up?
faqs.a: Reinvent Digital gives every enquiry a named owner and a follow-up plan by treatment, keeps clinical questions with people, and reports on bookings, not messages sent.

faqs.q: How does follow-up connect to walk-ins?
faqs.a: Within the Reinvent Digital Patient Acquisition System, every message and call outcome is recorded in your CRM, and bookings from follow-up are matched to walk-ins where you allow access.

closing.heading: How Many Patients Said “I'll Think About It” and Never Heard Back?
closing.body: Share a month of enquiries, and Reinvent Digital will show how many were never followed up, where they stalled, and which follow-ups to fix first.
